def net2str(net, outSTRM):
    """
    Writes the network object given as "inpNET" as a .str file readable by PHEM.
    Returns a map from the SUMO-road id to the generated numerical id used by PHEM.

    The following may be a matter of changes:
    - currently, only the positions of the start and the end nodes are written,
      the geometry of the edge as defined in the SUMO-network is not exported.
      A map between the edge id and a segment to a numerical id would be necessary
    """
    is returned.
        - currently, the start and end nodes are not connected by edges.

        Parameters
        ----------
        net : SUMO-network
            The network to be written.
        outSTRM : file
            The file to write the .str-file to.

        Returns
        -------
        edge2id : dict
            A map from the SUMO-edge id to the generated numerical id used by PHEM.
        """
        edge2id = {}
        for edge in net.edges:
            str2write = "edge\n"
            str2write += str(edge.id) + " " + str(len(edge.lanes)) + " " + str(edge.length) + " " + str(edge.fromNode.x) + " " + str(edge.fromNode.y) + " " + str(edge.toNode.x) + " " + str(edge.toNode.y) + " "
            for lane in edge.lanes:
                str2write += str(lane.speed) + " "
            str2write += "\n"
            outSTRM.write(str2write)
            edge2id[edge.id] = len(edge2id)
        return edge2id
